entry.title: Market brief — 12 November 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: on Thursday 12 November 2026 the Nifty 50 closed at 25,299.35 (+44.30, +0.18%) and the Sensex at 81,911.01 (+31.61, +0.04%), with the rupee about 35 paise weaker at 94.04 per dollar. IBJA's benchmark put 24K gold at Rs 1,38,294 per 10 g (-2,511) and 999 silver at Rs 1,81,999 per kg (-4,496).
